name: tt-glossary
note: Manifest of every dataset mirrored here. Resolve this file first, then read the URL of the dataset you need. No timestamp by design -- see scripts/build_index.py. Repo name is historical: it mirrors the content corpus too, not just the glossary.

authorities.glossary: The Localization Auditor app. Do not edit the legacy manual Sheet or these files by hand.
authorities.corpus: The corpus Sheet, fed by the Google Docs content index.

aliases.description: Old Help Center slugs that changed, so links can be rewritten.

articles.description: translationKey -> published EN/ES/PT Help Center URLs.

corpus.description: The full content index: Help Center articles + internal KAs, EN/ES/PT, including fullText and publishedUrl. Authority: the corpus Sheet.

glossary.description: Approved EN->ES terms with type (product/ui/term), context and status. Authority: the Localization Auditor app. status=rejected is dropped at sync.

glossary_md.description: Human-readable glossary, grouped by type. Generated from glossary.json; also the offline fallback bundled in the translation skill.

masterbook.description: Translation memory: previously approved ES content keyed by translationKey.
